subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Just'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4 is:** 'Just.'**
 
• The sentence is presenting a timeline of events - the end of the Porter sisters' careers coinciding with the start of the Brontë sisters'. 
 
• The word** "just"** is used in this context to mean "exactly at the same time" or "precisely at the moment that". 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lest: **This word is used to express fear or worry that a particular unwanted situation will happen. It does not fit the context here.
 
• **That: **In this context, "that" could potentially work if there was an antecedent for it to refer to, but as it stands, there is none.
 
• **Must: **This word is used to express an obligation, a necessity, or a high degree of certainty about a past event. It does not fit the context here.
